MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The Echo Show displays feel like useful additions to my Fire TV and connected home setup; I would choose the larger Show 8 over the Show 5 this time.",
    "The Blink bundle offers doorbell and indoor coverage that could extend my existing Blink setup, making it a more natural choice than starting with another camera brand."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Owning cameras does not mean I need more memory cards; I have no current storage shortage and have not confirmed that these cards fit my equipment.",
    "Earbuds, a portable speaker, and a USB hub serve needs I do not currently have. My recent purchases give me more reason to consider home video and security devices.",
    "The Echo Dot and WYZE camera have some relevance, but I prefer a display to a voice-only speaker and expanding Blink to adding a separate camera setup."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in electronics seems to have been stretched into an interest in general computer and audio accessories.",
    "My camera purchases seem to have been taken as a reason to offer storage and more cameras without considering whether they add something I need."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My existing Fire TV and Blink devices make additions that work with that setup more appealing than loosely related electronics.",
    "I care about the specific role an item would fill: a larger display or new doorbell coverage is more compelling than a smaller alternative or another outdoor camera that overlaps with what I own."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my interest in connected home video and security but extended it too broadly to accessories and devices without a clear current use."
}
